intent: Functional HttpInterceptorFn `devBackendInterceptor` answering with in-memory fixtures (HttpResponse, ~150 ms delay, no model imports; plain object literals) exactly: GET /api/trainer/profile -> {id:'t1',displayName:'Alex Carter',avatar:null,websiteUrl:'https://www.example-trainer.com'}; GET /api/telemetry/snapshot and GET /api/telemetry/live -> {id:'m1',heartRate,respiratoryRate,trainingLoad,updatedAt: ISO now} starting 128/24/72 with random walk (live) occasionally exceeding 180 bpm; GET /api/training-ratios -> [{id:'r1',primaryPercentage:30,secondaryPercentage:70,categoryLabel:'Strength vs Cardio'},{id:'r2',primaryPercentage:50,secondaryPercentage:50,categoryLabel:'Push vs Pull'}]; POST /api/training-ratios/reset -> the same array reset to initial values; GET /api/phases -> [{id:'p1',phaseName:'STEP 01',completionPercentage:80,status:'IN_PROGRESS'},{id:'p2',phaseName:'STEP 02',completionPercentage:20,status:'PENDING'},{id:'p3',phaseName:'STEP 03',completionPercentage:0,status:'PENDING'},{id:'p4',phaseName:'STEP 04',completionPercentage:0,status:'PENDING'}]; POST /api/phases/advance -> marks current IN_PROGRESS phase COMPLETED/100 and next one IN_PROGRESS, returns the array; GET /api/routines/:routineId/steps -> [{id:'s1',stepNumber:1,title:'Warm-up Sprint',description:'Jog in place for two minutes then accelerate to a controlled sprint.',isCompleted:false},{id:'s2',stepNumber:2,title:'Dumbbell Press',description:'Press the dumbbells overhead for 3 sets of 10 reps with controlled tempo.',isCompleted:false}]; POST /api/routines/:routineId/steps/:stepId/complete -> that step with isCompleted:true (state kept in memory). Unmatched requests call next(req).
